source_note: Original demonstration practice; not official MOE/SEAB questions.

questions.prompt: The glass slipped and ___ on the floor.
questions.explanation: Glass can shatter when it falls and breaks into pieces.

questions.prompt: Neither of the boys ___ absent today.
questions.explanation: “Neither” is treated as singular in this sentence, so use “is”.

questions.prompt: Lena packed an umbrella. At noon, dark clouds gathered and rain began. Why was the umbrella useful?
questions.explanation: An umbrella is useful because it helps keep a person dry in the rain.
